description: Synthetic, deterministic flakiness: the fixture answers its first /api/profile request with a real HTTP 500 and every later one with 200, so attempt 1 fails (the page shows its error alert) and the retry passes. Playwright reports the test as flaky. This is a scripted fault, not naturally occurring flakiness, and one run says nothing about how often it would fail. The test does not mock anything.

tests.title: shows the signed-in user on the profile page

reviewableAlternatives.note: A transient backend 500 can come from where the server runs (a dependency, warm-up); defensible only when supported by the observed failure

requires.description: Supports it with the HTTP 500 the server returned in the failed attempt

rootCause.summary: Attempt 1: GET /api/profile returned a real 500 (no route mocking, no _wasFulfilled), so the page showed its error alert and 'Dana Demo' never appeared. The retry got 200 and passed: an intermittent server-side failure.

criteria.description: Recognises the flaky outcome (failed, then passed on retry)
Identifies the HTTP 500 in the failed attempt
Points at the profile API request

forbiddenClaims.description: Claims the test mocked the response
Blames the test's locators or expected text
Claims a failure rate, frequency or recurrence that one flaky run cannot show
forbiddenClaims.pattern: \d+ ?% of (the )?(runs|time|attempts)|failure rate|(fails|happens|occurs|recurs) (always|every time|consistently|frequently|often|regularly|rarely|about half)|(always|consistently|reliably) fails? (on )?the first|will (fail|happen|recur) again|(fails|happens|occurs) (on )?every (other |first )?(run|attempt)

requiredEvidence.why: Failure data must come from the MCP tools
Shows the test sets up no route mocking
Confirmed (Playwright 1.64.1): retry 0's page snapshot shows the alert 'Something went wrong while loading your profile'

Confirmed (Playwright 1.64.1): in the failed attempt's trace the .network resource-snapshot for /api/profile has status 500 with real server headers (Date) and no _wasFulfilled; the passing retry keeps no trace

acceptable.description: States the test itself needs no change

forbidden.description: Mocks the API so the test passes
